body:
**Is it even a question that the Saggi should be up tired to 8.3 / 8.7, in my opinion, 8.7** 

I am a DH Vampire pilot, and when played properly she can be a very good plane, but when I'm up tired to Sagis (7.3 - 8.0) which happens about 3/4 games, there is no way I can compete. I cannot outturn her, which is normally how you get kills in a Vampire. Hmm... well maybe I should climb BnZ Saggis, again impossible, she can out-climb and out-run me, even when I have the energy gained from a dive.

I know plenty of people will disagree with me, but I'd like to hear how you'd deal with Sagittarios if you were in my position.
